native_mechanisms: Fold one crease per mark, each crease's angle determined jointly by the mark and the previous crease (strict sequential, order-dependent chaining).

Press every crease against all four distinct wire-bird beaks at once and refold tighter until all four agree, keeping the spiral/shell markings deliberately misaligned so no two mark-piles collapse alike.
Thin the whole folded wad at the water's edge down to one small dense coin-sized corner, discarding every scrap, spare sheet and failed gauge reading so only the token survives.
core_technique: xxHash64: four 64-bit accumulator lanes consuming 32-byte stripes with add-multiply/rotate/multiply rounds, rotate-and-sum lane merge plus per-lane mergeAccumulator, length injection, 8/4/1-byte tail folding, and an xor-shift/multiply final avalanche.
